Package com.codedstream.otterstream.context.spi

Interface ContextProvider

All Known Subinterfaces:
VectorSearchProvider
All Known Implementing Classes:
ConversationMemoryProvider, FeatureProviderContextAdapter, FlinkStateContextProvider, MemcachedContextProvider, PineconeContextProvider
public interface ContextProvider
A source of context to assemble before inference — the generalized parent abstraction behind otter-stream-context. Where com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi.FeatureProvider is a single-shot entity→feature lookup, ContextProvider is the broader shape: session/conversation memory, vector search results, cached state, or a feature lookup are all just different implementations of "given a request, produce some context." An existing FeatureProvider adapts trivially into one — see FeatureProviderContextAdapter — so none of the Redis/JDBC/Feast work from earlier needs to be duplicated.

Implementations must be safe for concurrent use — ContextEngine calls every configured provider in parallel for a single request, so a provider blocking one caller must not block another.

Since:
0.1.0

    • fetch

      Map<String,Object> fetch(String key, Map<String,Object> request) throws Exception
      Produces context for one request.
      Parameters:
      key - the entity/session/query key this request is for (a user id, a session id, a raw query string for vector search — meaning is provider-specific)
      request - additional request-scoped parameters a provider might need (e.g. how many vector matches to return, which conversation turns to include)
      Returns:
      the context this provider contributes, as a flat map
      Throws:
      Exception - if the underlying lookup/computation fails
